title: Nested open section unit compatibility
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V ≤ U opens [def-weil-open-immersion], i : V → U their inclusion, and F an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Put bW = (W,id), vW = (W,jW), f : vV → vU the inclusion, and t : bV → i.Etale(bU) the map (i,id). Let η_i be the inverse-image unit [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], c : jV^*F ≅ i^*jU^*F the canonical composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], and ρW : jW^*F ≅ F restricted to W the localization comparison [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction]. Then η_i(jU^*F)(bU) followed by (i^*jU^*F)(t), c inverse at bV, and ρV at bV equals ρU at bU followed by F(f). This is an equality of homomorphisms (jU^*F)(bU) → F(vV), including empty and equal opens.

proof.text: Work first with arbitrary coefficient category A, with Category.{u+1}, Abelian, IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u+1}, and HasSmallSiteSheafify instances. The private helper restriction_unit_coefficients proves the pointwise localization-unit formula for A, and the private helper composition_unit_coefficients proves the pointwise composition-unit formula for A. Specialize these to AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}. The generic pointwise localization-unit formula follows from Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app and naturality: η_j(b) followed by j^*F(ψ) and ρ_j(c) is F applied to the site adjunct of ψ. Apply it to δ = (id,id) : bU → U ×_X U. The site adjunct is id_vU by its first projection, so η_U(vU) followed by jU^*F(δ) is ρU inverse. Apply it to ψ = (i,id) : bV → U ×_X V; its site adjunct is f, giving η_V(vU) followed by jV^*F(ψ) and ρV = F(f).
Check by the outer and inner pullback projections that the site pullback composition comparison carries ψ to t followed by i.Etale(δ). This uses i followed by jU = jV and identity composition only.

Evaluate the composition-unit equation at vU and restrict along ψ. Substitute the preceding site-map identity, then move δ through the i unit by naturality. Replace the U unit followed by δ by ρU inverse. Thus η_V(vU) followed by jV^*F(ψ) and c equals ρU inverse followed by η_i(bU) and i^*jU^*F(t).
Compose with c inverse, precompose with ρU and postcompose with ρV. Cancel the inverse pairs and use the formula for ψ to obtain the stated equality.

theorem nestedOpenSection_unit {X : Scheme.{u}} (U V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    let bU := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 U.toScheme)
    let bV := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 V.toScheme)
    let vU : X.Etale := (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale U.ι)).obj bU
    let vV : X.Etale := (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale V.ι)).obj bV
    let f : vV ⟶ vU := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (X.homOfLE h)
      (by
        change X.homOfLE h ≫ (𝟙 U.toScheme ≫ U.ι) = 𝟙 V.toScheme ≫ V.ι
        simpa only [Category.id_comp] using X.homOfLE_ι h) trivial
    let t : bV ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (X.homOfLE h)).obj bU :=
      MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (pullback.lift (X.homOfLE h) (𝟙 V.toScheme)
        ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)) (by simp [bU, bV])
    ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (X.homOfLE h)).unit.app ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι).obj F)).hom.app
        (op bU) ≫
      ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (X.homOfLE h)).obj
        ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι).obj F)).obj.map t.op ≫
      ((Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (X.homOfLE h) U.ι V.ι
        (X.homOfLE_ι h).symm).inv.app F).hom.app (op bV) ≫
      ((Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} V.ι
        inferInstance).hom.app F).hom.app (op bV) =
      ((Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι
        inferInstance).hom.app F).hom.app (op bU) ≫ F.obj.map f.op
